description: Iteration 1 full spec: 6 archetypes, 5 rules, first draft from proxy targets only.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (discharge headway 0.35 s) and M3/share/car (0.004): a tau below the default 1 s shortens the discharge headway, low impatience keeps cars almost compliant.
Targets M8/car (wrong-lane share 0.068) and M9a (straight cars in the right-turn lane): a minority of cars that may seek space, with smaller lateral gaps.

Targets M1/moto (0.30 s), M4 (62% of halting motorcycles past the stop line, lateral spread) and M5/moto_density: small tau, minGap and minGapLat plus sublane pushing let riders filter forward and pack densely.
Targets M6/approach moto times (s ~36 s vs car 42 s): a slower own archetype riding in the lane centre via slow_lane_center.
Targets F2 (wrong lane 0.19-0.23, sidewalk 0.01-0.05, right lane 0.01-0.02) and M10a/M9a per cycle: custom1 riders that draw queue_space_seeking, with aggressive lateral parameters.
Targets M7a/M7b/M6 illegal_l (n_waiting 5.6, clear lag 5.5 s, 38 s approach): short jmTimegapMinor lets them enter and turn into small gaps when the opposing green ends.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (0.13 share in the last 10 s of red) and M2/first_delay; applied to motorcycles only because the car share is 0.011.

Targets M3/share/moto (0.098), M3/per_cycle (3.9) and M3/var_to_mean (1.14): small base probability with a mild swarm increase gives slight overdispersion, motorcycles only since the car share is 0.004.
Targets F2 probabilities (wrong lane ~0.2, right lane ~0.02, sidewalk ~0.05) and M9c/M10b (queue at choice ~15.5 m): trigger queue q=15 m, green check 7 s.
Targets M7a release_time (2.78 s after opposing green end) and M7b clear_lag (5.46 s): a modest extra hold of 1.5 s after the native release.
Targets behaviour 10 and M4/lat_moto: slow riders keep the lane centre (offset 0).
